date_plan.forward_rule: Freeze files, source facts and a qualifying manifest before opening any result. Derive exact exchange-session and 60/20/remainder split lists only from qualifying completed rows. Keep the final list unopened until one allowed final evaluation.

selected60.limits: Opening gaps remain. It does not prove a complete tape, original availability, finality, corrections, adjustments, point-in-time membership, historical borrow, historical options or untouched final dates.

benchmark_sector_etfs.limits: ETF inventory cannot replace the stock universe or qualify complete source coverage.

schwab_current_observation.limits: Dated current access only. Official units, NBBO fidelity, entitlement, continuity and historical execution remain unknown.

required_record_contracts.candidate_limit: Official documents describe a derived component-venue feed with anonymized trade venue and do not establish complete consolidated tape coverage or original availability. It can support only a separately labeled partial-source arm unless later evidence proves the full rule.

required_record_contracts.candidate_limit: Official Security Master material supports point-in-time listing facts. It does not by itself recreate the selected60 selection process, index membership, sector membership or original availability needed by this project.

required_fields: announcement, effective, ex and record dates when applicable

required_record_contracts.candidate_limit: Official OPRA material supports consolidated top-of-book and trade records. Options remain a separate unavailable result until every field passes.
